photos.llama_desc: A group of people sitting on a bench in a park. They are all smiling and looking at the camera. The group is made up of men and women of various ages and they are all dressed in casual, summer-style clothing.
photos.oracle_desc: Five people — a mix of adults and teenagers — stand and crouch together in front of a decorative fountain on a sunny day, with vibrant red flower beds flanking both sides of the fountain. All are smiling and posed for the camera in casual summer clothing. The paved plaza and bright sky suggest an outdoor public garden or tourist destination.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl in a pink onesie with a pattern of green and yellow creatures, holding a small grey stuffed elephant and a large grey stuffed elephant. She is sitting on a dark brown surface, with her arms around the larger elephant, and her face is smiling. The background is dark and out of focus.
photos.oracle_desc: A young girl wearing pink pajamas with a character print smiles broadly while hugging two grey stuffed elephants — one small and one large — against a dark, out-of-focus background. Her painted red fingernails are visible as she holds the smaller elephant in front of the larger one. The setting appears to be an indoor evening scene, possibly just before bed.

photos.llama_desc: A group of children in a swimming pool. They are playing in the pool's shallow end, with some of them playing with a pool toy. The pool is surrounded by a poolside area with a few chairs and a poolside table.
photos.oracle_desc: Several children are submerged in a small indoor hot tub or spa, photographed from directly above at night with the water lit from beneath in a blue-green glow. The image shows only the metal-edged tub and surrounding tile floor — no wider poolside area is visible. At least one child in a yellow swimsuit is clearly visible near the edge.

photos.llama_desc: A large, green, plastic, dinosaur-like creature in a dark, dimly lit, indoor, museum or theme park setting.
photos.oracle_desc: A detailed animatronic or sculpted dinosaur — brownish-green in color and approximately medium-sized — stands in a dimly lit museum diorama beside a prehistoric plant prop and a rocky ground surface. The scene recreates a prehistoric environment with careful attention to texture and lighting. The exhibit setting is consistent with a natural history museum.

photos.llama_desc: A group of children in a bowling alley. A boy in a brown sweater and blue jeans is about to throw a bowling ball. He is standing in the middle of a bowling lane, with his back to the camera.
photos.oracle_desc: Three boys are in a bowling alley viewed from behind, with one boy mid-approach in the lane while two others watch from behind the foul line. Colorful bowling-themed artwork lines the wall above the lanes, and pins are visible at the far end of two adjacent lanes. All three boys are wearing casual clothing in dark and muted tones.

photos.oracle_desc: Interior of Disney's "It's a Small World" ride shot looking upward, with dozens of colorful hanging puppet figures suspended from a dark ceiling above the iconic white-and-red-striped spire and onion-dome turrets. The puppets are dressed in varied international costumes and dangle on wires at different heights. The overall composition is dark with the decorative structures illuminated against the black ceiling.

photos.llama_desc: A group of three women in swim suits and a woman in a blue wetsuit. They are standing on the edge of a swimming pool, with the pool's blue and white tiles and a blue and white pool liner visible behind them. The women are smiling and posing for the camera, with their arms around each other.
photos.oracle_desc: Three females stand poolside in an indoor competitive swimming facility — two wearing dark one-piece racing swimsuits and one in a dark warm-up jacket — posing together for the camera. Lane lines and competition pool infrastructure are visible in the background. The atmosphere and attire suggest a swim meet or practice session.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a dark green dress is walking on a path in a park. She is wearing a dark green dress with a white or light-colouring around the neck and a dark green hat. She is walking on a path in a park with a green grassy area and a few trees in the background.
photos.oracle_desc: A woman stands outdoors in a park, rendered almost entirely as a dark silhouette due to severe backlighting from bright sunlight filtering through the trees behind her. Her face is barely visible and no clothing colors or details can be reliably discerned. Green grass and leafy trees fill the sunlit background.

photos.llama_desc: A woman holding a baby and a man sitting on a couch. The woman is holding a green balloon and the baby is wearing a white t-shirt with a green tie. The man is wearing a white and blue USA soccer jersey with a red and white American flag on it.
photos.oracle_desc: A woman holds a young toddler on her lap while seated next to a man on a couch, all three facing the camera in front of a deep red wall. The toddler grasps a yellow-green balloon, and the man wears a white USA soccer jersey. The scene has a casual, celebratory feel consistent with a birthday or family gathering.

photos.llama_desc: A group of six men sitting on stools in a dimly lit bar, with a bar counter and various beer bottles and glasses in the background.
photos.oracle_desc: Five men pose together inside a taproom or craft bar, with three standing toward the back and two seated or perched in front. Draft beer taps, bottles, and bar shelving are visible behind them, and the space has an industrial, casual atmosphere. The men are dressed in casual streetwear and appear relaxed and sociable.
